The diagonal corner Jacobians yield eight positive saddle rates and the exact product. Hyperbolic saddle passage estimates give the logarithmic return exponent and the strict attracting/repelling consequences. On the explicit slice the threshold follows by exact algebra, the only other formal equilibrium lies outside the square and the origin is an attracting focus. The basin boundary is nonempty compact invariant inside the square without equilibria, so Poincare--Bendixson guarantees an interior periodic orbit. Exact-rational witness and corner verification returned SQUARE_HETEROCLINIC_VERIFY_OK; these finite checks are supporting, not replacements for the proof.

A complete coefficient-level saddle-characteristic product identifies how the square changes stability while revealing cancellation of a nonlinear coefficient.
